GeneDef.label: nocturnal
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene prefer to be up at night. They are happier if awake at nights and unhappy if awake during the day.

GeneDef.label: crystalline skin
GeneDef.description: The organism of carriers of this gene merges with the organic crystal structure. Their skin takes on a crystallized form, shimmering in the light and making it resistant to blunt damage of any kind.

GeneDef.label: hive mind
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene possess a unique form of collective intelligence that connects them to others within the same colony. Members of the hive mind learn new skills much more quickly by sharing their experiences with one another.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Increasing skill learning speed per hive-linked colonists by 5%.

GeneDef.label: oviparous
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene lay eggs instead of giving live birth. Eggs need time and correct conditions to hatch.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Lays eggs instead of pregnancy and live birth.
Laying eggs makes the pawn temporarily infertile.

GeneDef.label: bird talons
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have hands that resemble bird feet. Their sharp claws allow them to deal sharp damage instead of blunt when unarmed in compensation of manipulation capability.
